title: What Vacuum Tube Freight Is
definition: Vacuum Tube Freight: freight capsules in evacuated tubes.
description:
Strip Vacuum Tube Freight to its essence and you get freight capsules in evacuated tubes. Simple to say, civilizational to build.

The path runs through Future Transport & Mobility: first capsule pods understanding, then tube logistics prototypes, then vacuum pumps operations at scale. Each stage has its own physics, its own economics, and its own failure modes — this database maps all three.

t: Real Research Today: Vacuum Tube Freight
title: Real Research Today: Vacuum Tube Freight
definition: Today's documented research behind Vacuum Tube Freight.
description:
The road to Vacuum Tube Freight is already being paved. Stratospheric balloons and airships (Sceye, Flying Whales) return as cargo platforms. The EU's SESAR and US NextGen modernize air-traffic control for denser skies.

Maglev lines (Shanghai, JR Tokai's Chuo Shinkansen) run revenue service above 400 km/h. Together these programs form the capsule pods foundation that Vacuum Tube Freight will build on — the tube logistics results, the vacuum pumps methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as tube logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2032 — First certified tube hulls service opens: capsule pods propulsio
title: 2032 — First certified tube hulls service opens: capsule pods propulsio

title: Readiness Estimator: Vacuum Tube Freight
definition: Estimates Vacuum Tube Freight readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Vacuum Tube Freight components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a tube hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Vacuum Tube Freight Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Vacuum Tube Freight operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Vacuum Tube Freight installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 51509 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where capsule pods monitoring, tube logistics redundancy, or vacuum pumps maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Vacuum Tube Freight Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Vacuum Tube Freight: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Vacuum Tube Freight — freight capsules in evacuated tubes.

Phase 1 — Prove (capsule pods): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (tube logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (vacuum pumps): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (switching yards): tube hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and logistics-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
